note: x, z: the hull's centre (m, local frame: x east, z south); heading: degrees from +z (south) towards +x (east) of the bow; length & beam: m; colour: the deck & hull's white or paint (the bright pixels); tone: the whole boat seen from above (an open boat's inside, its cover); accent: the strongest other colour (a painted hull, a cover); sRGB; hand: digitised by hand
